text:
anya: hey all, anya here — first day. trying to build runtime from source and nvcc/ptx toolchain is puking. anyone seen this?

anya: build cmd: `cmake -B build -S . -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo && cmake --build build -j8`

anya: ptx error:
```
ptxas fatal   : Value 'sm_86' is not defined for option '--gpu-name'
ptxas fatal   : Unrecoverable error, aborting
```

devon: welcome! :wave: that usually means your ptxas comes from an older CUDA install that doesn't know sm_86. what does `ptxas --version` and `nvcc --version` print?

anya: `which ptxas` -> `/usr/bin/ptxas`
anya: `ptxas --version` -> `ptxas 11.0`
anya: `nvcc --version` -> `Cuda compilation tools, release 11.0, V11.0.221`

ryan: repo expects arch sm_86 (we commonly target 8.6 for our test GPUs). our CI uses CUDA 11.8+ or 12.x. two quick fixes: install matching toolkit (recommended) or set `-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=Compatible;75` to compile a more compatible PTX.

jo: also check `/usr/local/cuda` symlink. sometimes distro packages put ptxas in `/usr/bin` and you end up mixing runfile headers with apt libs. run `readlink -f /usr/local/cuda` and `echo $PATH` to be safe.

anya: `readlink -f /usr/local/cuda` -> `/usr/local/cuda-11.0`
anya: PATH had `/usr/bin` before `/usr/local/cuda/bin`.

devon: try prepending `/usr/local/cuda/bin` to PATH or run `scripts/setup_cuda.sh` from repo which sets CUDA_HOME and fixes PATH/RPATH for builds. after that `which ptxas` should point at `/usr/local/cuda/bin/ptxas` (matching toolkit).

anya: I prepped PATH and re-ran, but ptxas was still 11.0 because the system only has 11.0 installed. I installed `cuda-toolkit-11-8` via apt and updated `/usr/local/cuda` symlink to 11.8.

anya: re-ran cmake clean build — success! binaries link and tests start. :tada:

ryan: nice. if you want to be extra safe, add a short note to the README about required CUDA minimum (we keep seeing 11.8 vs 12.x mismatches).

onboard-bot: Hi anya! Don't forget to complete the "Runtime dev setup" checklist in Notion and pick a mentor.

anya: will do, thanks everyone for the quick help.
_description: Onboarding thread: new hire hits ptxas 'sm_86' undefined error caused by older CUDA toolkit (ptxas 11.0); team suggests checking which ptxas/nvcc, updating PATH or installing 11.8+, and using scripts/setup_cuda.sh
